description: Aptos Move package framework layer — Move.toml with AptosFramework dep, resource-based module, #[test] suite.

buildHints.whenToUse: Aptos blockchain smart contracts — resource-based modules, on-chain state management, token contracts, DeFi protocols, or any product that needs to deploy and call Move modules on Aptos mainnet/devnet.
architectureNotes: Aptos Move: resources stored under signer account via move_to / borrow_global
Entry functions are callable from transactions; #[view] functions are read-only reads
Named address key is `module_addr` (static identifier in Move.toml [addresses]); supply the real address with --named-addresses module_addr=<your_address> at compile/publish time
Counter resource (key ability) stored under the owner's address; holds a u64 value and emits IncrementedEvent on each increment
firstSteps: Install the Aptos CLI: brew install aptos (macOS) or see https://aptos.dev/tools/aptos-cli/install-cli/
Run `aptos move compile --named-addresses module_addr=default` to type-check the module
Run `aptos move test --named-addresses module_addr=default` to execute the Move unit tests
Initialize a devnet account with `aptos init --network devnet` before publishing
Fund the account with `aptos account fund-with-faucet --account default` then publish with `aptos move publish --named-addresses module_addr=<your_address>`
gotchas: Aptos Move is NOT Sui Move — imports are aptos_framework::*, not sui::*. Don't copy Sui module patterns.
Resources can only be accessed with acquires: add `acquires Counter` to any function that reads/writes the resource.
move_to fails if the resource already exists under that account — use exists<T>(addr) as a guard in initialize.
Signer capability is non-copyable and non-droppable — pass by &signer reference, never try to store or clone.
Publishing requires the named address to be a real account with APT for gas: `aptos account fund-with-faucet` on devnet.
Move unit tests run in-VM and DON'T exercise storage the same way as on-chain execution — still test with real publish for production code.

placeholders.description: Move package name (e.g. MyProject); used in Move.toml [package].name and package.json name
Move module name (e.g. Counter); used in module declaration and as the source/test file basename

Static named-address key in Move.toml [addresses] — value is '_' meaning deferred to CLI. Pass the real address via --named-addresses module_addr=<your_address> at compile/publish time. This key is NOT a template placeholder; it is a fixed identifier in Move.toml.
